# Open-Meteo API guide

> An unofficial guide to the Open-Meteo forecast and geocoding APIs. Open-Meteo is a free weather API with no API key for non-commercial use (fewer than 10,000 calls per day). Data is licensed CC BY 4.0 and needs attribution.

Key facts:

- Forecast endpoint: GET https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast (requires latitude and longitude)
- Geocoding endpoint: GET https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search (requires name)
- Hourly and daily data are parallel arrays matched by index to a `time` array
- Errors return HTTP 400 with {"error": true, "reason": "..."}
- Set `timezone` (or `timezone=auto`) when requesting daily data

## Guides

- [Get your first forecast](https://elliottwhite252.github.io/api-docs-sample/tutorial/): geocode a city, then request current and daily data
- [Get a daily forecast](https://elliottwhite252.github.io/api-docs-sample/how-to/daily-forecast/): seven-day highs, lows, rain chance, and conditions
- [Change units](https://elliottwhite252.github.io/api-docs-sample/how-to/change-units/): Fahrenheit, mph, inches
- [Handle errors](https://elliottwhite252.github.io/api-docs-sample/how-to/handle-errors/): 400 errors, empty searches, rate limits

## Concepts

- [How responses are structured](https://elliottwhite252.github.io/api-docs-sample/concepts/response-structure/): parallel arrays, units, times, and coordinates

## Reference

- [OpenAPI spec](https://elliottwhite252.github.io/api-docs-sample/openapi.yaml): machine-readable description of both endpoints
- [API reference](https://elliottwhite252.github.io/api-docs-sample/reference/api/)
- [Weather codes](https://elliottwhite252.github.io/api-docs-sample/reference/weather-codes/): WMO code to description

## Optional

- [Official Open-Meteo documentation](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs): every parameter and variable
